mentions.name: TUI roguelike-style word game
mentions.description: A word game built with a TUI graphical style that looks like a roguelike but has more going on beneath the surface, with an emphasis on carefully developed game systems and meta rather than rapid development.
mentions.source_excerpt: i am working on a really cool word game that has a TUI graphical style, it looks like a roguelike but has a bit more going on.
